headline: Clinical Nurse Coordinator
summary: Clinical nurse coordinator with twelve years in acute and primary care in Baguio. I coordinate nursing care across medical and surgical wards, assess and monitor complex patients, and make sure documentation, consent and legal requirements are met. I lead and train a team of 30 nurses.
skills: Primary care and chronic disease follow-up
Basic and Advanced Cardiac Life Support

experience.title: Clinical Nurse Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate nursing care for two medical-surgical wards with 60 beds and 30 nurses.
Audit charts monthly for complete documentation and informed consent, raising compliance from 78% to 96%.
Lead discharge planning with doctors, social workers and families.
Run in-service training on sepsis recognition, fall prevention and patient rights.

experience.title: Senior Staff Nurse
bullets: Cared for acutely ill medical and surgical patients and led the night shift.
Precepted new graduate nurses during their first six months.

experience.title: Community Health Nurse
bullets: Ran primary care clinics for hypertension and diabetes in farming communities.
Followed up patients at home and kept them on their treatment plans.
